---
title: "CIN-MNH Maternity Documentation Report"
subtitle: "Weekly documentation of the key report variables"
date: today
date-format: "D MMMM YYYY"
params:
  source: "redcap"     # "redcap" (live API) or "synthetic" (test data)
  hospital: "91"       # hosp_id code, e.g. 91 = Lodwar, 72 = Pumwani; "all" = whole CIN-MNH network
  month: ""            # report month YYYY-MM; "" = last full calendar month
  start_date: ""       # optional custom period (YYYY-MM-DD); overrides month
  end_date: ""
  good: 0.90           # >= good: green (optimal)
  caution: 0.70        # >= caution: amber (needs attention); below: red (critical)
  show_disabled: false # true = keep rows for variables on disabled forms (shown as "Form disabled")
  cache: ""            # set by R/render_batch.R: one REDCap pull shared by all hospital reports
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    theme: cosmo
    mainfont: 'system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif'
    css: styles.css
  typst:
    template-partials:
      - page.typ
    include-before-body:
      - text: |
          #show table: set text(size: 7.5pt)
          #set table(inset: (x: 3pt, y: 2pt))
          #set par(justify: false)
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(knitr); library(kableExtra); library(lubridate); library(ggplot2) })
for (f in c("redcap_logic", "pipeline", "synthetic", "takeaways")) source(file.path("R", paste0(f, ".R")))
is_pdf <- !knitr::is_html_output()

# ---- period and hospital ----
p_date <- function(x) if (nzchar(as.character(x))) as.Date(as.character(x)) else NULL
if (!is.null(p_date(params$start_date)) && !is.null(p_date(params$end_date))) {
  start <- p_date(params$start_date); end <- p_date(params$end_date)
} else {
  m1 <- if (nzchar(params$month)) as.Date(paste0(params$month, "-01")) else floor_date(Sys.Date(), "month") %m-% months(1)
  start <- m1; end <- ceiling_date(m1, "month") - 1
}
h_par <- trimws(as.character(params$hospital %||% ""))
hospital <- if (!length(h_par) || !nzchar(h_par) || tolower(h_par) %in% c("all", "network")) NULL else h_par
x <- load_report_data(params$source, start, end, hospital, cache = params$cache)

# ---- cell formatting ----
col_good <- "#c9ebcc"; col_caution <- "#ffe1a6"; col_critical <- "#f6c1c1"; col_none <- "#ececec"
band <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), col_none, ifelse(p >= params$good, col_good, ifelse(p >= params$caution, col_caution, col_critical)))
cell <- function(pct, nd, ne, disabled = FALSE) {
  disabled <- rep_len(disabled, length(pct))   # ifelse() returns the length of its test: keep it vector-length
  txt  <- ifelse(disabled, "–", ifelse(ne == 0, "–", paste0(floor(pct * 100), "%")))   # floor: never 100% with gaps
  sub  <- ifelse(disabled | ne == 0, "", paste0(nd, "/", ne))
  fill <- ifelse(disabled | ne == 0, col_none, band(pct))
  if (is_pdf) {
    paste0("`#box(fill: rgb(\"", fill, "\"), inset: (x: 3pt, y: 2pt), radius: 2pt, width: 100%)[#align(center)[*", txt,
           "*", ifelse(nzchar(sub), paste0(" #linebreak() #text(size: 6pt)[", sub, "]"), ""), "]]`{=typst}")
  } else {
    paste0("<div style=\"background:", fill, ";border-radius:3px;padding:2px 4px;text-align:center;min-width:52px\"><b>", txt,
           "</b>", ifelse(nzchar(sub), paste0("<br><span style=\"font-size:0.75em;color:#3b3b3b\">", sub, "</span>"), ""), "</div>")
  }
}
chip <- function(fill, label) if (is_pdf)
  paste0("`#box(fill: rgb(\"", fill, "\"), inset: (x: 4pt, y: 1pt), radius: 2pt)[", label, "]`{=typst}") else
  paste0("<span style=\"background:", fill, ";border-radius:3px;padding:1px 6px\">", label, "</span>")
md_table <- function(df, align, widths) {
  al <- strsplit(align, "")[[1]]
  dash <- mapply(function(w, a) { d <- strrep("-", w); if (a == "r") paste0(substr(d, 2, w), ":") else if (a == "c") paste0(":", substr(d, 3, w), ":") else paste0(":", substr(d, 2, w)) }, widths, al)
  esc <- function(v) gsub("@", "\\@", gsub("|", "\\|", ifelse(is.na(v), "", as.character(v)), fixed = TRUE), fixed = TRUE)
  body <- apply(df, 1, function(r) paste0("| ", paste(esc(r), collapse = " | "), " |"))
  knitr::asis_output(paste(c("", paste0("| ", paste(names(df), collapse = " | "), " |"),
                             paste0("|", paste(dash, collapse = "|"), "|"), body, ""), collapse = "\n"))
}

# ---- week column labels, clipped to the period ----
wk_lab <- vapply(seq_along(x$weeks), function(i) {
  a <- max(x$weeks[i], start); b <- min(x$weeks[i] + 6, end)
  paste0("W", isoweek(x$weeks[i]), if (is_pdf) " " else "<br>",
         if (format(a, "%b") == format(b, "%b")) paste0(format(a, "%d"), "–", format(b, "%d %b")) else paste0(format(a, "%d %b"), "–", format(b, "%d %b")))
}, "")
disabled_rows <- x$rv$row[vapply(x$rv$fields_list, function(fs) {
  any(x$doc$disabled[x$doc$row %in% x$rv$row[vapply(x$rv$fields_list, identical, TRUE, fs)]]) }, TRUE)]
hidden_rows <- if (isTRUE(params$show_disabled)) integer() else disabled_rows   # left out of both tables
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Hospital:** `r x$hospital` · **Period:** `r period_name(start, end)` · **Mothers recorded in REDCap:** `r x$n_mothers` (`r x$n_mothers_prior` in `r period_name(x$prior_start, x$prior_end)`)`r if (x$source == "synthetic") " · **SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: not real**" else ""`

Each cell is the **% of mothers whose record documents the variable**, with *documented / expected* underneath. A variable is expected only where REDCap would show it, e.g. *referral type* only for referred mothers. `r chip(col_good, paste0("≥ ", params$good * 100, "% optimal"))` `r chip(col_caution, paste0(params$caution * 100, "–", params$good * 100 - 1, "% needs attention"))` `r chip(col_critical, paste0("< ", params$caution * 100, "% requires immediate action"))` `r chip(col_none, if (length(hidden_rows)) "– not expected that week" else "– not expected that week / form disabled")`
:::

## Key takeaways for action

```{r takeaways}
#| results: asis
cat(paste0("- ", build_takeaways(x, good = params$good, caution = params$caution), "\n"), sep = "")
```

## Admissions per week

Mothers recorded in REDCap each week. The dashed line is a typical week, scaled down for partial weeks at the start and end of the period; **red bars** are under half of typical, which usually means files have not been entered yet.

```{r admissions-chart}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 2.2
#| fig-dpi: 200
#| fig-alt: "Bar chart of mothers recorded per week, with low weeks highlighted in red"
vol <- weekly_volume(x) |>
  mutate(i = row_number(),
         lab = paste0("W", isoweek(week), "\n", format(pmax(week, start), "%d %b")),
         status = factor(ifelse(low, "Low", ifelse(partial, "Partial week", "Typical")),
                         levels = c("Typical", "Partial week", "Low")),
         inside = n >= 0.2 * max(n, expected),   # label inside the bar unless it is too short
         ink = ifelse(n == 0, "#c0392b", ifelse(inside & !(partial & !low), "white", "#3b3b3b")),
         txt = ifelse(partial, paste0(n, " (", days, "d)"), as.character(n)))
ggplot(vol, aes(i, n)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = status), width = 0.7) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = i - 0.42, xend = i + 0.42, y = expected, yend = expected),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, colour = "#3b3b3b") +
  geom_text(aes(y = ifelse(inside, n, pmax(n, expected)), label = txt, vjust = ifelse(inside, 1.5, -0.4),
                colour = ink, fontface = ifelse(n == 0, "bold", "plain")), size = 3) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Typical = "#5b7fa6", `Partial week` = "#a9bfd6", Low = "#c0392b"),
                    labels = c(Typical = "Typical", `Partial week` = "Partial week (fewer days)",
                               Low = "Low: under half of typical"), drop = FALSE, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = vol$i, labels = vol$lab, expand = expansion(add = 0.4)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mothers") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left", legend.key.size = unit(8, "pt"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## Weekly documentation

```{r table}
tb <- x$table |> filter(!row %in% hidden_rows) |> left_join(x$rv |> select(row, section, label), by = "row") |>
  mutate(disabled = row %in% disabled_rows, txt = cell(pct, n_documented, n_expected, disabled))
wide <- tb |> select(row, section, label, week, txt) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = week, values_from = txt) |> arrange(row)
period <- tb |> group_by(row) |> summarise(nd = sum(n_documented), ne = sum(n_expected), disabled = any(disabled), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(Period = ifelse(disabled, if (is_pdf) "`#box(fill: rgb(\"#ececec\"), inset: 3pt, radius: 2pt)[Form disabled]`{=typst}" else
                           "<div style=\"background:#ececec;border-radius:3px;padding:2px 4px;text-align:center\">Form disabled</div>",
                         cell(ifelse(ne > 0, nd / ne, NA), nd, ne)))
wide <- wide |> left_join(period |> select(row, Period), by = "row")
names(wide)[match(as.character(x$weeks), names(wide))] <- wk_lab

mothers <- c("Mothers admitted", vapply(x$weeks, function(w) as.character(x$mothers_by_week$n[x$mothers_by_week$week == w]), ""), as.character(x$n_mothers))
out <- wide |> select(-row, -section) |> rename(Variable = label)
out <- rbind(setNames(as.list(mothers), names(out)), out)

if (is_pdf) {
  secs <- c("", wide$section)
  pdf_rows <- list(); prev <- ""
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(out))) {
    if (nzchar(secs[i]) && secs[i] != prev) { pdf_rows[[length(pdf_rows) + 1]] <- c(paste0("**", secs[i], "**"), rep("", ncol(out) - 1)); prev <- secs[i] }
    r <- unlist(out[i, ]); if (i == 1) r[1] <- "**Mothers admitted**"
    pdf_rows[[length(pdf_rows) + 1]] <- r
  }
  pdf_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, pdf_rows), stringsAsFactors = FALSE); names(pdf_df) <- names(out)
  nw <- length(x$weeks)
  md_table(pdf_df, paste0("l", strrep("c", nw + 1)), c(34, rep(max(8, floor(56 / (nw + 1))), nw + 1)))
} else {
  kbl(out, escape = FALSE, align = c("l", rep("c", ncol(out) - 1))) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "hover"), full_width = TRUE, font_size = 13) |>
    row_spec(1, bold = TRUE, background = "#f4f3ef") |>
    column_spec(1, width_min = "17em") |>
    pack_rows(index = c(" " = 1, table(factor(wide$section, levels = unique(wide$section)))))
}
```

```{r by-hospital-heading}
#| results: asis
if (isTRUE(x$network)) cat("\n## Documentation by hospital\n\n% documented for the whole period, by site. Columns are ordered from highest to lowest overall documentation.\n")
```

```{r by-hospital}
if (isTRUE(x$network)) {
  hosp_cfg <- read_cfg("config/hospitals.csv")
  bh <- period_summary(x$doc, x$rv, by_hosp = TRUE) |> filter(!is.na(hosp), hosp %in% hosp_cfg$hosp_id, !row %in% hidden_rows)
  site_order <- bh |> filter(!is.na(ne)) |> group_by(hosp) |> summarise(p = sum(nd) / sum(ne), .groups = "drop") |> arrange(desc(p)) |> pull(hosp)
  mothers_site <- x$doc |> distinct(record_id, hosp) |> count(hosp)
  hw <- bh |> mutate(disabled = row %in% disabled_rows,
                     txt = cell(ifelse(!is.na(ne) & ne > 0, pct, NA), coalesce(nd, 0L), coalesce(ne, 0L), disabled)) |>
    select(row, section, label, hosp, txt) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = hosp, values_from = txt) |> arrange(row)
  for (h in site_order) if (!h %in% names(hw)) hw[[h]] <- NA
  hw <- hw |> select(row, section, label, all_of(site_order))
  hw[is.na(hw)] <- cell(NA, 0L, 0L)
  hw <- hw |> left_join(period |> select(row, Network = Period), by = "row")
  short <- setNames(hosp_cfg$short, hosp_cfg$hosp_id)
  names(hw)[match(site_order, names(hw))] <- short[site_order]
  top <- c("Mothers", as.character(mothers_site$n[match(site_order, mothers_site$hosp)]), as.character(x$n_mothers))
  hout <- hw |> select(-row, -section) |> rename(Variable = label)
  hout <- rbind(setNames(as.list(top), names(hout)), hout)
  if (is_pdf) {
    secs <- c("", hw$section); rows <- list(); prev <- ""
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(hout))) {
      if (nzchar(secs[i]) && secs[i] != prev) { rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- c(paste0("**", secs[i], "**"), rep("", ncol(hout) - 1)); prev <- secs[i] }
      r <- unlist(hout[i, ]); if (i == 1) r[1] <- "**Mothers**"; rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- r
    }
    hdf <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, rows), stringsAsFactors = FALSE); names(hdf) <- names(hout)
    ns <- length(site_order)
    md_table(hdf, paste0("l", strrep("c", ns + 1)), c(30, rep(max(6, floor(60 / (ns + 1))), ns + 1)))
  } else {
    kbl(hout, escape = FALSE, align = c("l", rep("c", ncol(hout) - 1))) |>
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "hover"), full_width = TRUE, font_size = 13) |>
      row_spec(1, bold = TRUE, background = "#f4f3ef") |>
      column_spec(1, width_min = "17em") |>
      pack_rows(index = c(" " = 1, table(factor(hw$section, levels = unique(hw$section)))))
  }
}
```

### Notes

```{r notes}
#| results: asis
dis_forms <- gsub("_", " ", x$fdl$disabled)
cat(sprintf("- **Week** = Monday-start week of the mother's admission date (data-entry date when the admission date is missing). Columns are clipped to the report period, so the first and last weeks can be partial.\n"))
cat(sprintf("- **Documented** = a real answer. %s counts as documented (it is how *Other* is recorded); %s count as missing.\n",
            paste(documented_codes, collapse = ", "), paste(setdiff(x$missing_codes, documented_codes), collapse = ", ")))
cat("- **Admissions per week:** a week is *low* when it has no mothers, or fewer than half of a typical week (the median of the full weeks, scaled to the days a partial week covers).\n")
cat("- **Decision-to-delivery interval** counts as documented only when all four of the CS decision date, CS decision time, delivery date and delivery time are filled in.\n")
if (length(dis_forms))
  cat(sprintf("- **Form disabled:** the REDCap form display logic currently switches off **%s** (condition `1=2`), so their variables cannot be entered and are not expected%s. These are the report's labour, delivery and outcome sections; re-enabling the forms is the first step to documenting them.\n",
              paste(dis_forms, collapse = ", "),
              if (length(hidden_rows)) sprintf("; their %d variable%s %s left out of the tables above", length(hidden_rows),
                                               if (length(hidden_rows) > 1) "s" else "", if (length(hidden_rows) > 1) "are" else "is") else ""))
cat(sprintf("- Source: %s, pulled %s.\n", if (x$source == "redcap") "CIN Standard Maternal Tool (REDCap, via REDCapR)" else "synthetic test data", format(x$pulled_at, "%d %b %Y %H:%M")))
```
